findings.title: Pages declare several competing H1 headings
findings.evidence: 3 pages have more than two <h1> elements, e.g. https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-runners has 3.
findings.mechanism: Several H1s leave no single statement of the page's subject, so the extracted topic is diluted.

suggested_action.summary: Keep one H1 per page and demote the rest to H2/H3 in reading order.

not_applicable.reason: served HTML already contains substantial text on every page
homepage states the organisation's category in extractable text
